design.model: frozen Gemma 4 E2B QAT on owned WebGPU engine
design.task: Hebrew NPC RPG, English metadata, CEFR A1 vs B2, 5 scripted learner turns, sampling temp 1 top-k 64 top-p 0.95, seed 23 (best_of_2 adds seed 47)
design.arms: raw_base (canonical prompt), strong_prompt (level-specific instructions), best_of_2 (strong prompt, dev judge picks of seeds 23/47), agent_rank1/random_rank1/wrong_level_gate/no_op_overlay (canonical prompt + residual rank-1 overlay at layer 22, alpha 0.06)
design.judges: 4 blind role-specific LLM sub-agent judges (language, cefr with target level, level estimator without target, conversation), same underlying model family as the orchestrator; calibrated only on AI-authored contrasts (level ordering 9/9, agreement 36/36, matched>mismatched suitability 18/18); conversation judge uncalibrated
design.n: 6 development scenario families x 2 levels, 1 episode per cell per arm

dev_panel.no_op_overlay: identical token-for-token to raw_base in 12/12 dev episodes (not separately judged)
